summary: setup gathers facts automatically for plays or ad hoc. It includes facter_ and ohai_ facts if installed, filter only matches first-level keys and isn't available on Windows, and BSD needs elevated privileges for some facts.
questions: How do I see all facts Ansible collects for a host?
Does setup include facter or ohai data?
Why can't I use filter on Windows facts?
Why is ansible_product_version missing on BSD?

answer_card.title: Gather facts with setup
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.setup` gathers facts (auto-run by plays; ad hoc with `ansible host -m setup`).
- If `facter`/`ohai` are installed, their data is added with `facter_`/`ohai_` prefixes.
- `filter` only matches first-level keys under `ansible_facts`; not supported on Windows.
- Run with elevated privileges on BSD for facts like `ansible_product_version`.
